items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I tried writing for that band

ctx.x: Yes. One time--this may have been before that even, when we were playing the Apollo and I didn't want to commute, I stayed at the Teresa, and there I do recall getting some strange looks, because people just didn't do that. I was very naive and I didn't know anything about that. I had no sense of

anything of that nature.
Then Red got tangled up with
Mildred and then came to stay there a couple
of nights and then up in Maine, having been
in New Orleans, there was a Rudy Vallee band
and they got stranded in Maine too.

Red went up on that, Mildred
came up and before Mildred came, Red roomed
with me too, always encouraging me to write.
I tried writing for that band; Tootie wrote
for the band too.
